notes.title: 1.5.7 Version Update Description
notes.content:
1. Added grid display for players to determine their body position and flight speed
2. Added a new mode of player confrontation, which is an offline player confrontation mode
3. Other repairs and adjustments
4. In online mode and survival battle, 20 points will be deducted for death (to prevent victory through brute force)

notes.content:

Added two leaderboards related to player rivalry
The shops and hangars have been adjusted, and now the plane is not permanent.
Add a new forest map
Other BUG fixes and rationalizations
The probability of treasure box has been adjusted reasonably
